name: Base, front left
note: Front left quarter, with half of the speaker grille and the glowing light bar. The four quarters bolt together on internal ribs.
print: Print upside down (top deck on the bed). No supports.

name: Base, front right
note: One quarter of the base. The four quarters bolt together on internal ribs; the base holds the speaker, the light bar, the electronics and the power socket.
print: Print upside down (top deck on the bed). No supports.

name: Base, rear left
note: One quarter of the base. The four quarters bolt together on internal ribs; the base holds the speaker, the light bar, the electronics and the power socket.
print: Print upside down (top deck on the bed). No supports.

name: Base, rear right
note: One quarter of the base. The four quarters bolt together on internal ribs; the base holds the speaker, the light bar, the electronics and the power socket.
print: Print upside down (top deck on the bed). No supports.

name: Bottom plate, front left
note: Closes the base. Screws into the bosses; rubber feet sit in the recesses. The rear plate has cooling vents under the electronics.

name: Bottom plate, front right
note: Closes the base. Screws into the bosses; rubber feet sit in the recesses. The rear plate has cooling vents under the electronics.

name: Bottom plate, rear left
note: Closes the base. Screws into the bosses; rubber feet sit in the recesses. The rear plate has cooling vents under the electronics.

name: Bottom plate, rear right
note: Closes the base. Screws into the bosses; rubber feet sit in the recesses. The rear plate has cooling vents under the electronics.

name: Pillar, front left, lower
note: Corner pillar holding the smoked side panel with a glowing edge line on its front face. A 10 mm steel rod runs through all pillar sections for stiffness.

name: Pillar, front left, upper
note: Upper section of the corner pillar; joins the lower section over the steel rod.

name: Pillar, front right, lower
note: Corner pillar holding the smoked side panel with a glowing edge line on its front face. A 10 mm steel rod runs through all pillar sections for stiffness.

name: Pillar, front right, upper
note: Upper section of the corner pillar; joins the lower section over the steel rod.

name: Pillar, rear left, lower
note: Corner pillar holding the smoked side panel and the black back panel. A 10 mm steel rod runs through all pillar sections for stiffness.

name: Pillar, rear left, upper
note: Upper section of the corner pillar; joins the lower section over the steel rod.

name: Pillar, rear right, lower
note: Corner pillar holding the smoked side panel and the black back panel. A 10 mm steel rod runs through all pillar sections for stiffness.

name: Pillar, rear right, upper
note: Upper section of the corner pillar; joins the lower section over the steel rod.

name: Reflector rail, left, lower
note: Holds the edge of the beam-splitter glass at exactly 45 degrees. The lower piece has a foot that screws to the base deck.
print: Print lying on its side, no supports.

name: Reflector rail, left, upper
note: Upper half of the 45-degree rail; its tab screws to the underside of the crown.
print: Print lying on its side, no supports.

name: Reflector rail, right, lower
note: Holds the edge of the beam-splitter glass at exactly 45 degrees. The lower piece has a foot that screws to the base deck.
print: Print lying on its side, no supports.

name: Reflector rail, right, upper
note: Upper half of the 45-degree rail; its tab screws to the underside of the crown.
print: Print lying on its side, no supports.

name: Holo pad diffuser
note: Glows from an LED ring underneath. It pulses when she speaks and changes colour with her mood.

name: Holo pad cover
note: The emitter she stands on, at exactly the spot where her reflected image meets the floor, so her feet land on it. Sixteen light windows over the diffuser.

name: Crown, front left
note: Front quarter: holds the screen face-down above the reflector, with the camera window and a mic hole. The four quarters bolt together on centre ribs.
print: Print upside down (top on the bed).

name: Crown, front right
note: Front quarter: holds the screen face-down above the reflector, with the camera window and a mic hole. The four quarters bolt together on centre ribs.
print: Print upside down (top on the bed).

name: Crown, rear left
note: Rear quarter with half the exhaust grille and the cable exit. The four quarters bolt together on centre ribs.
print: Print upside down (top on the bed).

name: Crown, rear right
note: Rear quarter with half the exhaust grille and the cable exit. The four quarters bolt together on centre ribs.
print: Print upside down (top on the bed).

name: Screen clips (set of 4)
note: Screw onto the top of the screen ledge and press the screen down so it cannot shift. Foam pads stop rattles.
print: Print flat, all four at once.

name: Camera bracket
note: Holds a small USB camera board behind the front window so she can see and face you.

name: Electronics tray
note: Mounts the ESP32, the amplifier board, the USB hub and the power board in the rear of the base.

name: Speaker baffle
note: Holds a 3 inch full-range speaker behind the front grille.

name: Light bar diffuser
note: A glowing strip across the front of the base, lit by the same LEDs as the pad.

name: 17.3 inch portable monitor (portrait, face down)
note: Shows her on pure black. About 400 x 245 mm, USB-C or HDMI, as bright as possible (500 nits or more). Its long side runs front to back so her reflection stands tall.

name: Screen picture area
note: The 382 x 215 mm picture area.

name: Beam-splitter glass, about 258 x 545 mm
note: Teleprompter glass (about 70/30) at 45 degrees. It reflects the screen so she appears standing inside, while you still see through it.

name: Smoked acrylic side panel left
note: Dark tinted 3 mm acrylic, 476 x 400 mm. Keeps the inside dark so she looks bright, but you can still see into the capsule.

name: Smoked acrylic side panel right
note: Dark tinted 3 mm acrylic, 476 x 400 mm. Keeps the inside dark so she looks bright, but you can still see into the capsule.

name: Matte black back panel
note: Black 3 mm foam board or acrylic. The darker the background, the more solid she looks.

name: 3 inch speaker + amplifier
note: Full-range driver behind the grille.

name: USB camera board
note: Small 1080p USB camera.

name: Where her image appears (about 38 cm)
note: A flat stand-in shape marking where her reflected image stands, right above the holo pad. Her real model never goes into these files.
